caption: The drawing depicts a single, brown-colored scoop shovel positioned diagonally on a plain, off-white background. The shovel has a flat, wide blade and a straight handle ending in a simple D-shaped grip. There are no other objects or embellishments present in the composition, and the name "Pearl Davis" is written in small text near the lower left area of the drawing. The illustration focuses solely on the shovel, rendering it in realistic tones and shading to emphasize its form and texture.
title: Wooden Grain Shovel
